cues.en: You're listening to the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 你正在收听 BBC World Service 的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Oliver Conway. We're recording this at 04:00 GMT on Monday, the 7th of September.
cues.zh: 你好，我是奥利弗·康威。节目录制于9月7日星期一格林尼治标准时间04:00。

cues.en: The AfD secures the biggest election win for the German far right since the Nazi era.
cues.zh: 德国选择党赢得了纳粹时代以来德国极右翼最大的一场选举胜利。

cues.en: US envoys leave Ukraine with no breakthrough on ending Russia's war.
cues.zh: 美国特使离开乌克兰，结束俄罗斯战争的谈判没有取得突破。

cues.en: And the BBC investigates a claim that individuals working for the Saudi government might have been involved in the 9/11 attacks.
cues.zh: BBC 还调查了一项指控：为沙特政府工作的人员可能参与了9·11袭击。

cues.en: Also in this podcast...
cues.zh: 本期播客还将谈到……

cues.en: I remember it often. It makes me feel sad, and I cry.
cues.zh: 我常常想起那件事。这让我感到悲伤，我会哭。

cues.en: We hear from Nigerians who survived a school abduction, and we take a look at sleepmaxing.
cues.zh: 我们将听取从学校绑架中幸存的尼日利亚人讲述，并了解“睡眠优化”。

cues.en: We begin with what could be a significant moment for post-war Germany.
cues.zh: 我们先关注这可能是战后德国一个重要时刻的事件。

cues.en: Supporters of the AfD celebrating a landslide election victory in the former East German state of Saxony-Anhalt.
cues.zh: 在前东德的萨克森-安哈尔特州，德国选择党的支持者庆祝压倒性的选举胜利。

cues.en: It was the biggest win for the far right in Germany since the Nazi era.
cues.zh: 这是纳粹时代以来德国极右翼赢得的最大胜利。

cues.en: The party more than doubled its support, taking 44% of the vote.
cues.zh: 该党的支持率翻了一倍多，获得44%的选票。

cues.en: Though it fell just short of a majority of seats in the state parliament.
cues.zh: 但距离在州议会取得过半席位仍差一点。

cues.en: It was a very bad result for the German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. His party's vote was halved.
cues.zh: 这对德国总理弗里德里希·默茨而言是非常糟糕的结果。他所在政党的得票率减半。

cues.en: The man who now hopes to become the first AfD Chief Minister of any German state, 35-year-old Ulrich Siegmund, said they'd made history.
cues.zh: 35岁的乌尔里希·西格蒙德希望成为德国首位选择党籍州长；他说，他们创造了历史。

cues.en: This election victory is a vote of confidence from the people of this country, and we will live up to that trust.
cues.zh: 这场选举胜利是这个国家人民投下的信任票，我们将不辜负这份信任。

cues.en: We will not compromise our principles. We will not give up on ourselves.
cues.zh: 我们不会牺牲自己的原则，也不会放弃自我。

cues.en: We will never become like those who've rightly been punished this evening. We are Alternative for Germany.
cues.zh: 我们绝不会变成那些理应在今晚受到惩罚的人。我们是德国选择党。

cues.en: The AfD tapped into a wave of nostalgia for communist East Germany.
cues.zh: 德国选择党借助了对东德共产主义时期的怀旧情绪。

cues.en: And managed to secure support from at least 150,000 previous non-voters.
cues.zh: 并至少争取到15万名此前不投票者的支持。

cues.en: The party wants to heavily restrict immigration, restore ties with Russia, quit the euro, and promote unashamed German patriotism.
cues.zh: 该党希望严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、退出欧元区，并公开推动德国爱国主义。

cues.en: Defunding so-called ‘anti-German art’, and teaching children less about Hitler.
cues.zh: 他们还要停止资助所谓的“反德艺术”，少教孩子一些关于希特勒的内容。

cues.en: Mainstream politicians have refused to work with the AfD, but a small left-wing pro-Russia party
cues.zh: 主流政客拒绝与德国选择党合作，但一个亲俄的小型左翼政党，

cues.en: might provide support if it can get into the state parliament.
cues.zh: 如果能进入州议会，可能会提供支持。

cues.en: As our correspondent there Jessica Parker told Tim Franks:
cues.zh: 驻当地记者杰西卡·帕克向蒂姆·弗兰克斯介绍了情况：

cues.en: All eyes are on whether the smaller party BSW, or BSW as it's known here,
cues.zh: 所有人都在关注小党 BSW，也就是这里所称的 BSW，

cues.en: whether it's going to reach the 5% threshold that could allow it to get into parliament.
cues.zh: 能否达到5%的门槛，从而进入议会。

cues.en: The reason that's important is BSW have signalled that they would maybe be open to helping the AfD actually take power.
cues.zh: 之所以重要，是因为 BSW 已表示，他们或许愿意帮助德国选择党在这个州真正掌权。

cues.en: in this state, even if it wouldn't be any kind of formal coalition.
cues.zh: 在这个州掌权，即便并不组成任何正式联盟。

cues.en: If the BSW didn't make it into parliament, the AfD would potentially get more seats, more likely to get state-level power.
cues.zh: 如果 BSW 未能进入议会，德国选择党可能获得更多席位，也更有可能在州一级掌权。

cues.en: So, still some convoluted German political maths going on here. But the big picture is they've won in terms of voter share.
cues.zh: 所以，德国政治的复杂算术仍在进行。但大局是，他们在得票率方面赢了。

cues.en: The AfD, big. They've won, and they've won big here in Saxony-Anhalt.
cues.zh: 德国选择党赢得很大；他们赢了，而且在萨克森-安哈尔特州大胜。

cues.en: And in terms of both the state, I mean, obviously, states in Germany have a considerable amount of power,
cues.zh: 就这个州而言——我的意思是，德国各州显然拥有相当大的权力，

cues.en: not unfettered power, so that could be important.
cues.zh: 但权力并非不受限制，因此这可能很重要。

cues.en: But nationally, what does this huge victory for the AfD mean, do you think?
cues.zh: 但在全国层面，你认为德国选择党的这场巨大胜利意味着什么？

cues.en: Nationally, I think it means the AfD feels that they're on the march and they have been growing in popularity.
cues.zh: 在全国层面，我认为这意味着德国选择党觉得自己正在壮大，受欢迎程度也一直上升。

cues.en: They're leading the polls nationally, even though their support is heavily skewed to eastern Germany.
cues.zh: 他们在全国民调中领先，尽管支持者主要集中在德国东部。

cues.en: I think as well, it's a bad night for Friedrich Merz, the Chancellor, CDU, who was already very embattled.
cues.zh: 我还认为，这对总理、基民盟的弗里德里希·默茨来说是糟糕的一晚；他本已深陷困境。

cues.en: But this could potentially further destabilize him and his government. Now remember, his government is, for example, a key supporter of Ukraine.
cues.zh: 但这可能进一步动摇他和他的政府。请记住，例如，他的政府是乌克兰的重要支持者。

cues.en: Whereas the Alternative for Deutschland want to end support to Ukraine and have pro-Russia policies.
cues.zh: 而德国选择党希望停止对乌克兰的支持，并奉行亲俄政策。

cues.en: Now, as you say, important to understand.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，理解这一点很重要。

cues.en: States, they don't set foreign policy. State governments, but they do run things like education, policing, culture.
cues.zh: 各州——州政府并不制定外交政策，但确实负责教育、警务和文化等事务。

cues.en: So, as well, I think for the AfD, they see this as a potential blueprint
cues.zh: 所以，我也认为，对德国选择党来说，他们把这看作一个潜在样板，

cues.en: for how they would look in power in other states or indeed nationally,
cues.zh: 展示他们在其他州乃至全国掌权时可能的样子，

cues.en: something that they aspire to. So they're seeing it as a stepping stone for their aspirations.
cues.zh: 那是他们的目标，所以他们把这看作实现抱负的垫脚石。

cues.en: Whereas other people, I think critics of the AfD, of which there are many in Germany—this is a party classed as right-wing extremist in this state
cues.zh: 而其他人，我想是德国众多的选择党批评者——该党在这个州被认定为右翼极端主义政党，

cues.en: by domestic intelligence—critics of the party fear this is a moment
cues.zh: 这是国内情报部门的认定；批评者担心，现在是一个

cues.en: of peril for the country if indeed there is some kind of domino effect.
cues.zh: 国家面临危险的时刻，如果确实出现某种多米诺骨牌效应。

cues.en: Jessica Parker in Saxony-Anhalt.
cues.zh: 杰西卡·帕克在萨克森-安哈尔特州报道。

cues.en: President Trump's envoys have left Ukraine after talks with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统的特使在与总统泽连斯基会谈后离开了乌克兰。

cues.en: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visited Kyiv after talks in Moscow with Vladimir Putin.
cues.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳在莫斯科与弗拉基米尔·普京会谈后访问了基辅。

cues.en: As expected, there was no breakthrough on ending Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
cues.zh: 正如预期，在结束俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵问题上没有取得突破。

cues.en: Our diplomatic correspondent James Landale is in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 我们的外交事务记者詹姆斯·兰代尔在基辅。

cues.en: This is the first time Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have set foot on Ukrainian soil
cues.zh: 这是史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳首次踏上乌克兰土地，

cues.en: since Russia's full-scale invasion, and they arrived by train because they couldn't risk flying and running the gauntlet of Russian drones.
cues.zh: 自俄罗斯全面入侵以来，他们乘火车抵达，因为不敢冒险乘飞机、穿越俄罗斯无人机的火力网。

cues.en: But the welcome they got was warm, a chance for President Zelenskyy finally to give them his assessment
cues.zh: 但他们受到了热烈欢迎，这也让泽连斯基总统终于有机会向他们当面介绍自己的战况判断，

cues.en: of the war first-hand here on the ground in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 在基辅这里的战地，第一手地介绍这场战争。

cues.en: He chose to greet the US envoys in the city's famous Saint Sophia Cathedral,
cues.zh: 他选择在这座城市著名的圣索菲亚大教堂迎接美国特使，

cues.en: not only a symbol of Ukraine's ancient past, but also only yards from where
cues.zh: 那里不仅是乌克兰古老历史的象征，距离俄罗斯袭击过的地方也只有几码，

cues.en: Russia attacked the headquarters of the country's security services on Friday.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯周五袭击了乌克兰国家安全部门的总部。

cues.en: Both sides said the talks were substantive and they appeared good-humored,
cues.zh: 双方都表示会谈内容充实，而且气氛似乎很友好，

cues.en: including jokes at Russia's expense.
cues.zh: 其中还拿俄罗斯开了些玩笑。

cues.en: They were joined later by European national security advisers,
cues.zh: 后来，欧洲各国的国家安全顾问也加入了他们，

cues.en: but was anything actually agreed?
cues.zh: 但双方究竟达成了什么协议吗？

cues.en: Well, they discussed new ideas to end the war in a fresh round of US-brokered talks,
cues.zh: 他们在新一轮由美国斡旋的会谈中，讨论了结束战争的新想法，

cues.en: but President Zelenskyy's focus was on his need for more energy and air defences now.
cues.zh: 但泽连斯基总统关注的是目前对更多能源和防空力量的需求。

cues.en: We very much hope that we will be able to reach agreements with our American partners,
cues.zh: 我们非常希望能够与美国伙伴达成协议，

cues.en: and we are counting on the support of our European partners if the war continues in winter,
cues.zh: 如果战争延续到冬季，我们指望欧洲伙伴的支持，

cues.en: and this is how it appears at the moment.
cues.zh: 目前看来，情况就是这样。

cues.en: President Zelenskyy reiterated Ukraine's red lines for peace: security guarantees and a strong army,
cues.zh: 泽连斯基总统重申了乌克兰的和平红线：安全保障和一支强大的军队，

cues.en: something Russia opposes.
cues.zh: 而俄罗斯反对这些要求。

cues.en: Mr. Witkoff hoped a deal could be done.
cues.zh: 威特科夫先生希望能够达成协议。

cues.en: It's going to take both sides to make some compromises and narrow the issues between them,
cues.zh: 双方都需要作出一些妥协，缩小彼此之间的分歧，

cues.en: and we think we have the ingredients to get to that place.
cues.zh: 我们认为已经具备了实现这一目标的条件。

cues.en: But in the Kremlin yesterday, there was little sign of compromise.
cues.zh: 但昨天在克里姆林宫，几乎没有妥协的迹象。

cues.en: President Putin insisting the root causes of the war must be addressed,
cues.zh: 普京总统坚持认为，必须处理这场战争的根本原因，

cues.en: shorthand for Ukraine giving up territory and self-determination.
cues.zh: 这实际上是在说，乌克兰要放弃领土和自决权。

cues.en: Today, his forces launched yet another attack on a town in western Ukraine, hitting an apartment block, injuring seven.
cues.zh: 今天，他的部队再次袭击乌克兰西部一座城镇，击中一栋公寓楼，造成7人受伤。

cues.en: Talk of ceasefires and diplomacy not saving them from Russian drones.
cues.zh: 停火与外交的讨论并没有让他们免遭俄罗斯无人机袭击。

cues.en: James Landale in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯·兰代尔在基辅报道。

cues.en: Twenty-five years after the September 11th attacks,
cues.zh: 在9·11袭击25年后，

cues.en: new evidence is raising questions about a man who helped two of the hijackers after they arrived in America.
cues.zh: 新的证据让人们开始质疑一名男子，他曾在两名劫机者抵达美国后帮助过他们。

cues.en: Saudi national Omar al-Bayoumi was arrested in Britain just days after 9/11.
cues.zh: 沙特人奥马尔·巴尤米在9·11事件几天后于英国被捕。

cues.en: He was never extradited back to the US, although compelling evidence against him was uncovered by British police and shared with the FBI.
cues.zh: 他从未被引渡回美国，尽管英国警方发现了对他不利的有力证据，并将其提供给了联邦调查局。

cues.en: This report from Jane McMullen.
cues.zh: 以下是简·麦克马伦的报道。

cues.en: It's a day that I would like to only think of my husband, and we can't do that if the truth remains buried.
cues.zh: 这一天我只想缅怀我的丈夫，但如果真相继续被掩埋，我们就做不到这一点。

cues.en: Terry Strada's husband Tom, with whom she had three children, was working in New York's World Trade Center when the attacks happened.
cues.zh: 特里·斯特拉达的丈夫汤姆与她育有3个孩子，袭击发生时正在纽约世贸中心工作。

cues.en: I had a newborn in my arms; he was four days old.
cues.zh: 我怀里抱着一个新生儿，他才4天大。

cues.en: Tom went down the stairs, turned around, said, 'I'll be home by two. I love you.'
cues.zh: 汤姆下了楼梯，又转过身来说：‘我两点前回家。我爱你。’

cues.en: Tom was one of nearly 3,000 people who were killed that day.
cues.zh: 汤姆是当天遇难的近3000人之一。

cues.en: The plane has crashed into the World Trade Center.
cues.zh: 飞机撞进了世贸中心。

cues.en: The passenger plane crashing into the South Tower.
cues.zh: 客机撞向南塔。

cues.en: Within days of the attacks, in which four planes were crashed, investigators had identified the 19 al-Qaeda hijackers.
cues.zh: 袭击发生后的几天内，调查人员确认了19名基地组织劫机者；当时共有4架飞机坠毁。

cues.en: Two of them, Nawaf al-Hazmi and Khalid al-Mihdhar, had lived for months in San Diego.
cues.zh: 其中两人纳瓦夫·哈兹米和哈立德·米德哈尔曾在圣迭戈生活数月。

cues.en: The FBI quickly discovered that they had received help from a Saudi man called Omar al-Bayoumi.
cues.zh: 联邦调查局很快发现，他们得到了一名叫奥马尔·巴尤米的沙特男子帮助。

cues.en: We needed to know everything about them.
cues.zh: 我们需要了解他们的一切。

cues.en: Danny Gonzalez was an FBI special agent.
cues.zh: 丹尼·冈萨雷斯曾是联邦调查局特工。

cues.en: You focus on who helped them, who assisted them.
cues.zh: 你要关注的是谁帮助了他们、协助了他们。

cues.en: It was a network. But when you see who's the principal of this network, it's Omar al-Bayoumi.
cues.zh: 这是一个网络。但当你看到这个网络的核心人物是谁时，就会发现是奥马尔·巴尤米。

cues.en: Bayoumi helped the two men secure an apartment, co-signing their lease.
cues.zh: 巴尤米帮助这两人租到了一套公寓，并共同签署了租约。

cues.en: But before 9/11, he moved to the UK, and 11 days after the attacks, British police arrested him in Birmingham.
cues.zh: 但在9·11之前，他搬到了英国；袭击11天后，英国警方在伯明翰将他逮捕。

cues.en: They took him to London, where he was questioned for seven days.
cues.zh: 他们把他带到伦敦，在那里对他审问了7天。

cues.en: This interview is being audio and video recorded.
cues.zh: 这次访谈正在进行音频和视频录制。

cues.en: At first, Bayoumi denied knowing the hijackers.
cues.zh: 起初，巴尤米否认认识这些劫机者。

cues.en: I don't have any link with any hijacker.
cues.zh: 我和任何劫机者都没有关系。

cues.en: But investigators already knew he had guaranteed two of the hijackers' rent.
cues.zh: 但调查人员早已知道，他曾为两名劫机者的房租作担保。

cues.en: Eventually, he admitted to helping them after what he said was a chance meeting in Los Angeles.
cues.zh: 最终，他承认在洛杉矶帮助过他们，但称那次相遇只是巧合。

cues.en: Bayoumi claimed to be a student who had no links to extremists.
cues.zh: 巴尤米声称自己是一名学生，与极端分子没有联系。

cues.en: But Panorama has obtained Bayoumi's personal videos, never broadcast before,
cues.zh: 但《全景》节目获得了巴尤米从未公开播出的私人视频，

cues.en: of Anwar al-Awlaki, who would go on to lead al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula.
cues.zh: 内容是安瓦尔·奥拉基的；他后来领导了阿拉伯半岛基地组织。

cues.en: When questioned in 2021, Bayoumi denied knowing Awlaki.
cues.zh: 2021年接受询问时，巴尤米否认认识奥拉基。

cues.en: But the videos show them paintballing and also embracing at a meeting.
cues.zh: 但视频显示，他们一起玩彩弹射击，还在一次会议上相拥。

cues.en: Awlaki, get ready to shoot!
cues.zh: 奥拉基，准备射击！

cues.en: After 9/11, the FBI uncovered evidence and information suggesting Bayoumi might have been working on behalf of Saudi interests.
cues.zh: 9·11事件后，联邦调查局发现证据和信息，显示巴尤米可能在为沙特利益工作。

cues.en: Rick Lambert oversaw the FBI investigation in San Diego.
cues.zh: 里克·兰伯特负责监督联邦调查局在圣迭戈的调查。

cues.en: There was a general consensus of people in the San Diego Muslim community that Bayoumi was an operative of the Saudi intelligence service.
cues.zh: 圣迭戈穆斯林社群普遍认为，巴尤米是沙特情报机构的特工。

cues.en: He was a spy? He was a spy.
cues.zh: 他是间谍？他是间谍。

cues.en: Bayoumi has always denied being a spy.
cues.zh: 巴尤米一直否认自己是间谍。

cues.en: British police also seized evidence from his Birmingham home,
cues.zh: 英国警方还从他位于伯明翰的住所查获了证据，

cues.en: including a video he filmed around the Capitol building two years before the attacks.
cues.zh: 其中包括一段他在袭击发生前两年于国会大厦周边拍摄的视频。

cues.en: At the time, al-Qaeda was deciding which targets to hit.
cues.zh: 当时，基地组织正在决定袭击哪些目标。

cues.en: Capitol Hill. Time is six p.m.
cues.zh: 国会山。现在是下午6点。

cues.en: Bayoumi later claimed it was tourism.
cues.zh: 巴尤米后来声称那只是旅游。

cues.en: But in it, he talked about a plan.
cues.zh: 但在视频中，他谈到了一个计划。

cues.en: The police also seized a handwritten diagram of a plane with descent calculations.
cues.zh: 警方还查获了一张手写的飞机图，上面有下降计算。

cues.en: Here's Jodi Westbrook Flowers, a lawyer representing the families of 9/11 victims
cues.zh: 这位是朱迪·韦斯特布鲁克·弗劳尔斯律师，她代表9·11遇难者家属，

cues.en: in a lawsuit against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
cues.zh: 参与针对沙特阿拉伯王国的诉讼。

cues.en: It's the mathematical calculation of the crash.
cues.zh: 这是飞机坠毁的数学计算。

cues.en: When we figured out what it was, we knew that it was the smoking gun that we'd been looking for.
cues.zh: 当我们弄清它是什么时，就知道这正是一直在寻找的确凿证据。

cues.en: Jeff Breinholt was an official at the Department of Justice.
cues.zh: 杰夫·布雷因霍尔特曾任司法部官员。

cues.en: The flight designs and calculations is the worst—that's the most inconvenient evidence for him, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 这些飞行设计和计算是最糟糕的——在我看来，这是对他最不利的证据。

cues.en: We've convicted people for less.
cues.zh: 我们曾因更少的证据判人有罪。

cues.en: When they found the diagram, the Met marked it up as top priority and handed it to the FBI.
cues.zh: 他们发现这张图后，伦敦警察厅将其列为最高优先级，并交给了联邦调查局。

cues.en: But neither the FBI nor the Met told the detectives interviewing Bayoumi about it.
cues.zh: 但联邦调查局和伦敦警察厅都没有告诉审问巴尤米的侦探。

cues.en: He wasn't asked about the diagram while he was in custody.
cues.zh: 他被拘押期间，没有人问及这张图。

cues.en: It's not clear why.
cues.zh: 原因并不清楚。

cues.en: FBI documents show it was decided there was insufficient evidence to extradite Bayoumi to the United States.
cues.zh: 联邦调查局文件显示，当时认定没有足够证据将巴尤米引渡到美国。

cues.en: He was released and returned to Saudi Arabia, where he remains.
cues.zh: 他获释后回到沙特阿拉伯，并一直留在那里。

cues.en: September 11th, when it comes around every year...
cues.zh: 每年到了9月11日这一天……

cues.en: As they mark the 25th anniversary of the attacks,
cues.zh: 在纪念袭击25周年之际，

cues.en: the families hope they can take their case against Saudi Arabia to a trial and get all the answers to what happened.
cues.zh: 家属希望能将针对沙特阿拉伯的案件提交审判，彻底弄清事情的真相。

cues.en: The FBI declined to comment.
cues.zh: 联邦调查局拒绝置评。

cues.en: While the US Department of Justice says it's unable to comment on matters and decisions,
cues.zh: 美国司法部则表示，无法就相关事务和决定置评，

cues.en: from 25 years ago involving staff who no longer work there.
cues.zh: 这些是25年前的事务，涉及如今已离职的员工。

cues.en: The Metropolitan Police says it can't comment because of the ongoing legal case.
cues.zh: 伦敦警察厅称，由于案件仍在审理，无法置评。

cues.en: Panorama attempted to reach Omar al-Bayoumi through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Islamic Affairs.
cues.zh: 《全景》节目试图通过外交部和伊斯兰事务部联络奥马尔·巴尤米。

cues.en: Neither he nor the Saudi government responded to our request for comment.
cues.zh: 他本人和沙特政府都没有回应我们的置评请求。

cues.en: He has previously denied knowing that Hazmi and Mihdhar would go on to be hijackers, said the plane diagram was just an equation, and denied any involvement in the 9/11 attacks.
cues.zh: 他此前否认知道哈兹米和米德哈尔后来会成为劫机者，称飞机图只是一个方程式，并否认参与9·11袭击。

cues.en: Jane McMullen reporting.
cues.zh: 简·麦克马伦报道。

cues.en: How well did you sleep last night?
cues.zh: 你昨晚睡得好吗？

cues.en: Well, these days many of us use smartwatches, rings, and apps to get a precise answer to that question.
cues.zh: 如今，我们许多人使用智能手表、戒指和应用，精准回答这个问题。

cues.en: But experts are warning that the pursuit of the perfect sleep, a trend known as sleepmaxing, could actually end up keeping people awake.
cues.zh: 但专家警告说，对完美睡眠的追求，这种被称为“睡眠优化”的趋势，实际上可能让人彻夜难眠。

cues.en: Doctors call it orthosomnia, an unhealthy obsession with getting the perfect night's rest.
cues.zh: 医生称之为“完美睡眠焦虑”，即对获得完美夜间休息的不健康痴迷。

cues.en: Dr. Alanna Hare is a sleep medicine consultant.
cues.zh: 阿兰娜·黑尔医生是睡眠医学顾问。

cues.en: What I often see is individuals who are very focused on high performance, well-being, maybe they're going to the gym,
cues.zh: 我经常看到一些人非常关注高水平表现和身心健康，也许他们还会去健身，

cues.en: and quite understandably, they also want to address their sleep and improve that.
cues.zh: 而且可以理解，他们也想改善睡眠。

cues.en: But unfortunately, sleep doesn't respond in the same way as diet and exercise do.
cues.zh: 但遗憾的是，睡眠并不会像饮食和锻炼那样回应努力。

cues.en: When we really focus on our sleep and we try and optimize or max our sleep,
cues.zh: 当我们过度关注睡眠，努力优化或最大化睡眠时，

cues.en: actually, often that can create the opposite issue where our sleep becomes worse.
cues.zh: 实际上，这往往会造成相反的结果，让睡眠变得更糟。

cues.en: Well, in a study at the University of Oxford, scientists gave participants trackers which displayed a score each time they woke up.
cues.zh: 牛津大学的一项研究中，科学家给参与者佩戴追踪器，每次醒来都会显示一个分数。

cues.en: These were actually just random numbers, but participants with low scores said they genuinely felt more tired and less mentally alert.
cues.zh: 这些其实只是随机数字，不过分数较低的参与者却说，他们确实感觉更疲惫、精神也更不清醒。

cues.en: James Wilson, or "The Sleep Geek", works with professional sports teams to improve athletes' rest.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯·威尔逊（“睡眠极客”）与职业运动队合作，帮助运动员改善休息。

cues.en: What we believe about our sleep is often the thing that comes true.
cues.zh: 我们对睡眠的看法，往往会变成现实。

cues.en: So there's lots of things that feed into how we sleep.
cues.zh: 影响我们睡眠的因素有很多。

cues.en: We have an underlying sort of genetic makeup when it comes to sleep, in terms of how much sleep we need,
cues.zh: 说到睡眠，我们有某种潜在的遗传构成，决定我们需要多少睡眠，

cues.en: in terms of how good and how much, your sleep type,
cues.zh: 也决定睡眠的质量、时长和睡眠类型，

cues.en: when you are more suited to going to bed and waking up.
cues.zh: 以及你更适合何时入睡和醒来。

cues.en: But then, then we also have the world around us, our lives around us,
cues.zh: 不过，我们也有身边的世界，有我们周围的生活，

cues.en: and if you've been a poor sleeper for your whole life,
cues.zh: 如果你一生都睡不好，

cues.en: often it's that story of, "you know, I'm not going to sleep tonight because of X, Y, and Z,"
cues.zh: 常常会有这样的想法：“你知道，因为这个、那个，我今晚睡不着。”

cues.en: that then causes you not to sleep that night.
cues.zh: 而这种想法反过来让你当晚无法入睡。

cues.en: And a big cause of that, and a big cause of something that's become known as orthosomnia,
cues.zh: 造成这种情况的一个重要原因，也是所谓“完美睡眠焦虑”的重要成因，

cues.en: is tracking your sleep.
cues.zh: 就是追踪你的睡眠。

cues.en: You know, if you are a poor sleeper, you know, you are a poor sleeper.
cues.zh: 你知道，如果你睡眠质量差，你知道，你就是睡眠质量差。

cues.en: You don't need a device to give you a score that might actually not be quite true.
cues.zh: 你不需要一个设备给你打分，而那个分数实际上可能并不准确。

cues.en: You know, you can wake up feeling okay, but if the score says you've slept poorly, that can really change how you view your sleep.
cues.zh: 你可能醒来时感觉还不错，但如果分数说你睡得不好，这真的会改变你看待睡眠的方式。

cues.en: If we actually acknowledge that sometimes sleep is a little bit difficult and our jobs can affect how we sleep
cues.zh: 如果我们承认，有时睡眠确实有点困难，而且工作会影响我们的睡眠，

cues.en: but know that our bodies can get us through it, then it doesn't have the same impact.
cues.zh: 但知道身体能帮助我们熬过去，它就不会造成同样的影响。

cues.en: So a lot of my work with the people I work with is actually getting them to reconfigure how they see their sleep
cues.zh: 所以，我与共事者的大部分工作，其实是帮助他们重新看待自己的睡眠，

cues.en: and accept that sometimes we will sleep poorly because we've got kids, we've got pets, we live in a noisy neighborhood
cues.zh: 并接受我们有时会睡不好，因为我们有孩子、有宠物，住在嘈杂的社区，

cues.en: we're shift workers, we've got a disability or neurodivergence, or we're living with a menstrual cycle or the menopause.
cues.zh: 我们是轮班工人，有残障或神经多样性，或者正经历月经周期或更年期。

cues.en: All these things can impact our sleep, and if we start to sort of obsess over it and think that sleep's got to be perfect, then you won't perform well.
cues.zh: 所有这些都会影响睡眠；如果我们开始过度纠结，认为睡眠必须完美，就无法发挥好。

cues.en: So the athletes I work with, a lot of the work is actually giving a bit of context
cues.zh: 所以，对我合作的运动员，许多工作其实是提供一些背景，

cues.en: around their sleep and trying to get them to see, you know, you're an elite athlete, sleep will not always be perfect.
cues.zh: 帮助他们理解睡眠，让他们明白，你知道，即便是精英运动员，睡眠也不会总是完美。

cues.en: Sleep expert James Wilson.
cues.zh: 睡眠专家詹姆斯·威尔逊。

cues.en: And still to come in this podcast
cues.zh: 本期播客接下来还将谈到，

cues.en: as a woman, I thought it was wonderful because I feel safer.
cues.zh: “作为一名女性，我觉得这太棒了，因为我感到更安全。”

cues.en: I just put some of my drink on it to test it.
cues.zh: 我只要把一点饮料滴在上面测试即可。

cues.en: A wristband that can detect whether your drink has been spiked.
cues.zh: 一种能检测饮料是否被下药的腕带。

cues.en: You're listening to the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 你正在收听《Global News Podcast》。

cues.en: Iran's top negotiator has warned of a faster, heavier and more painful response to US attacks as hostilities escalate.
cues.zh: 随着敌对行动升级，伊朗首席谈判代表警告称，将对美国的攻击作出更快、更猛烈、更痛苦的回应。

cues.en: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said the Americans must understand, quote,
cues.zh: 穆罕默德·巴盖尔·加利巴夫说，美国人必须明白，引述原话：

cues.en: before it's too late that the rules of the game have changed.
cues.zh: “趁还不算太晚，明白游戏规则已经改变。”

cues.en: Charlotte Gallagher spoke to the BBC Persian Service's Parham Ghobadi.
cues.zh: 夏洛特·加拉格尔采访了 BBC 波斯语部的帕尔哈姆·戈巴迪。

cues.en: In the past few days, Iranian commanders have been saying that Iran has shifted its military doctrine from defensive to offensive.
cues.zh: 过去几天，伊朗指挥官一直表示，伊朗已将军事学说从防御转为进攻。

cues.en: They laid out some of the features of it, saying that responses are going to be fast, are going to be broad
cues.zh: 他们列出了一些特点，称回应将会迅速且广泛，

cues.en: Iran may resort to preemptive strike, and this disproportionate response, it appears, is the fourth feature of Iran's new military doctrine.
cues.zh: 伊朗可能采取先发制人的打击；看来，这种不对称回应是伊朗新军事学说的第四个特点。

cues.en: Why do you think they are doing this?
cues.zh: 你认为他们为什么要这样做？

cues.en: Because Iran feels that it is losing its leverage over the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 因为伊朗觉得自己正在失去对霍尔木兹海峡的影响力。

cues.en: This is really important. The other thing, because the naval blockade, US naval blockade, is hurting Iran's weak economy.
cues.zh: 这非常重要。另一点是，美国的海上封锁正严重打击伊朗疲弱的经济。

cues.en: Really badly, and, you know, people are bearing the brunt of it.
cues.zh: 打击非常严重，而且你知道，民众正承受其最沉重的影响。

cues.en: Iran has two options, technically. One is going back to the negotiating tables from a weaker position.
cues.zh: 严格来说，伊朗有两个选择。一是从更弱的立场回到谈判桌。

cues.en: The second one is to escalate further.
cues.zh: 二是进一步升级局势。

cues.en: So it appears that Iranian authorities have chosen the latter
cues.zh: 所以看来，伊朗当局选择了后者，

cues.en: and they've decided to go up the escalation ladder, which has a risk of unintended consequences
cues.zh: 他们决定沿升级阶梯继续上行，这可能带来意外后果，

cues.en: and things spiral out of control.
cues.zh: 让事态失去控制。

cues.en: And is that their leverage, ramping up the escalation?
cues.zh: 那么，提升事态等级就是他们的筹码吗？

cues.en: Yep. So from the data that we have
cues.zh: 是的。所以根据我们掌握的数据，

cues.en: like US authorities have for the first time put out a figure saying that they are transferring
cues.zh: 比如，美国当局首次公布数据，称他们正在运输，

cues.en: almost 9 million barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 约有900万桶石油通过霍尔木兹海峡。

cues.en: Before the war, it was somewhere around 20 million barrels, so that's something around 45 percent of oil transfer has been restored
cues.zh: 战前约为2000万桶，因此石油运输已恢复到约45%，

cues.en: by the Americans. So Iran feels that, yeah, obviously, it's not like the pre-war
cues.zh: 这是美国人恢复的。所以伊朗认为，显然，情况已不像战前，

cues.en: it is, you know, it's really costly for the Americans.
cues.zh: 你知道，这对美国人来说代价确实很高。

cues.en: They have to deploy troops, warships, etc., etc.
cues.zh: 他们必须部署军队、军舰等等。

cues.en: But they've managed to transfer some oil through the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 但他们已经设法让部分石油通过霍尔木兹海峡。

cues.en: Forty-five percent of that is already restored.
cues.zh: 其中45%已经恢复。

cues.en: So Iranians feel that they're being targeted, they're losing their most important leverage and, at the same time, the naval blockade is continuing.
cues.zh: 所以伊朗人觉得自己正受到针对，正在失去最重要的筹码，同时海上封锁仍在继续。

cues.en: So Iran cannot. According to reports, Iran's oil sales have dropped to zero, and that is Iran's main income and main revenue.
cues.zh: 所以伊朗做不到。据报道，伊朗的石油销售已降至零，而这是伊朗的主要收入来源。

cues.en: And this is what some Iranian authorities had warned already: that we should not overplay our hands
cues.zh: 这正是一些伊朗官员此前已经警告过的：我们不应把手牌打得太过，

cues.en: including Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, who mentioned this today.
cues.zh: 包括今天提到这一点的穆罕默德·巴盖尔·加利巴夫。

cues.en: He was one of those people who was saying that our benefit is in the Strait of Hormuz functioning and ships going through it.
cues.zh: 他就是认为，让霍尔木兹海峡保持运行、让船只通过，才符合我们利益的人之一。

cues.en: Persian service.
cues.zh: 波斯语部报道。

cues.en: At least five people have been killed after an Amazon cargo plane overshot the runway as it tried to land at Miami International Airport.
cues.zh: 一架亚马逊货运飞机试图降落迈阿密国际机场时冲出跑道，至少五人死亡。

cues.en: I got the details from the BBC's Anna Aslam.
cues.zh: 我从 BBC 记者安娜·阿斯拉姆那里获得了详情。

cues.en: This cargo plane took off from San Juan in Puerto Rico.
cues.zh: 这架货机从波多黎各的圣胡安起飞。

cues.en: It was coming in to land at Miami International shortly before 2:00 p.m. local time when it overran the runway.
cues.zh: 当地时间下午2点前不久，飞机准备降落迈阿密国际机场时冲出了跑道。

cues.en: Flight data shows it was going about 200 kilometres per hour when it, you know, hit the runway,
cues.zh: 飞行数据表明，飞机当时以每小时约200公里的速度飞行，然后，你知道，撞上了跑道，

cues.en: kept going, then just went off the runway completely.
cues.zh: 继续向前，随后完全冲出了跑道。

cues.en: It crossed a large road, hitting several vehicles there, and then burst into flames
cues.zh: 飞机穿过一条大路，撞上了那里的几辆车，随后起火，

cues.en: before grinding to a halt in what's called the field,
cues.zh: 最后在所谓的场地停了下来，

cues.en: but really just a grassy area sort of in between that road and a parking lot.
cues.zh: 但那其实只是一片位于那条路和停车场之间的草地。

cues.en: Videos and pictures online show the tilted plane, so you've got the damaged nose on the ground,
cues.zh: 网上的视频和图片显示，飞机倾斜着，受损的机头落在地面上，

cues.en: tail high up in the air with the Amazon logo visible, and then large plumes of smoke just coming off of it.
cues.zh: 机尾高高翘在空中，可以看到亚马逊标志，机身还不断冒出大片烟雾。

cues.en: Firefighters arrived pretty quickly, extinguished the flames, leaving soot on the wreckage.
cues.zh: 消防员很快赶到，扑灭了火焰，残骸上留下了煤烟。

cues.en: The fire chief Ray Jadallah said it was a complex situation.
cues.zh: 消防局长雷·贾达拉说，情况很复杂。

cues.en: The airplane did strike a couple of vehicles, and a couple of victims were actually trapped in the vehicles.
cues.zh: 飞机确实撞上了几辆车，有几名受害者被困在车内。

cues.en: So a complex extrication with our technical rescue team started to occur.
cues.zh: 因此，我们的技术救援队开始进行复杂的救援脱困工作。

cues.en: In addition to that, we had a very complex fire: engine compartments that were on fire,
cues.zh: 除此之外，我们还要处理非常复杂的火情：发动机舱起火，

cues.en: including a search and rescue of the pilot and co-pilot that were trapped in this aircraft.
cues.zh: 还要搜救被困在机内的飞行员和副驾驶。

cues.en: So as you said, we know five people have been killed.
cues.zh: 所以，正如你所说，我们知道已有5人死亡。

cues.en: Another five are injured, three in critical condition.
cues.zh: 另有5人受伤，其中3人伤势危重。

cues.en: Do we know what caused the plane to run off the end of the runway?
cues.zh: 我们知道飞机冲出跑道尽头的原因吗？

cues.en: Not yet. It's still an active scene, and federal investigators have said they've sent a team to go out there.
cues.zh: 还不知道。现场仍在处置中，联邦调查人员说他们已经派出一支小组前往现场。

cues.en: Amazon released a statement. It said it's working with local authorities to gather details about exactly what happened.
cues.zh: 亚马逊发表声明说，正在与地方当局合作，了解事件的确切经过。

cues.en: And a spokesperson said the loss of life was heartbreaking.
cues.zh: 一名发言人说，人员伤亡令人心碎。

cues.en: A dedicated hotline has been set up for the relatives of those affected.
cues.zh: 有关方面已为受影响者的亲属设立专线。

cues.en: County Mayor Daniela Levine Cava said the community is grieving.
cues.zh: 县长丹妮拉·莱文·卡瓦说，社区正处于悲痛之中。

cues.en: Today is an incredibly difficult day for all of us here in Miami-Dade County.
cues.zh: 今天对我们迈阿密-戴德县的所有人来说，都是极其艰难的一天。

cues.en: My heart is with all of the families who were affected and to everyone who is grieving tonight.
cues.zh: 我牵挂着所有受影响的家庭，也牵挂着今晚正在悲痛中的每一个人。

cues.en: And we're also praying for the injured and for their families.
cues.zh: 我们也为伤者及其家人祈祷。

cues.en: The airport was obviously completely shut down after that incident.
cues.zh: 事发后，机场显然完全关闭。

cues.en: Now, as it reopens, travelers have been told to expect delays and possibly cancellations.
cues.zh: 如今机场重新开放，旅客被告知可能会延误，甚至取消航班。

cues.en: Miami International is one of the busiest airports in the US, especially this weekend because of Labor Day bank holiday,
cues.zh: 迈阿密国际机场是美国最繁忙的机场之一，尤其本周末正值劳动节银行假日，

cues.en: so there will be a lot of disruption in the coming hours.
cues.zh: 因此，未来几小时将出现大量交通混乱。

cues.en: Anna Aslam.
cues.zh: 安娜·阿斯拉姆。

cues.en: Meanwhile, ash sent into the sky from an erupting volcano has closed eight airports in Indonesia,
cues.zh: 与此同时，一座正在喷发的火山将火山灰送入空中，导致印度尼西亚8座机场关闭，

cues.en: leading to the cancellation of more than a thousand flights.
cues.zh: 超过1000个航班因此被取消。

cues.en: Lisa Tambunan reports from Jakarta.
cues.zh: 丽莎·坦布南从雅加达报道。

cues.en: The eruption began late on Friday and sent ash nearly 10 miles into the sky.
cues.zh: 火山喷发始于周五深夜，将火山灰喷到近10英里高的空中。

cues.en: Mount Anak Krakatau, which sits in the Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra, was active once again.
cues.zh: 位于爪哇岛和苏门答腊岛之间巽他海峡的阿纳克·喀拉喀托火山再次活动。

cues.en: The seismic activity has continued through the weekend, with two more eruptions triggering widespread flight disruption.
cues.zh: 地震活动持续到周末，另外两次喷发引发了大范围航班中断。

cues.en: These passengers at Indonesia's main international airport near Jakarta...
cues.zh: 这些在雅加达附近、印度尼西亚主要国际机场的乘客……

cues.en: didn't know how long they would have to wait for a flight.
cues.zh: 不知道还要等多久才能乘上航班。

cues.en: If a volcano erupts, I understand that.
cues.zh: 如果火山喷发，我能理解。

cues.en: The problem is, why weren't we informed?
cues.zh: 问题是，为什么没人通知我们？

cues.en: That way, passengers wouldn't have needed to come here.
cues.zh: 那样，乘客就不必来这里了。

cues.en: It has caused problems for me.
cues.zh: 这给我带来了麻烦。

cues.en: People are waiting for me, but this is nature. I have to accept it.
cues.zh: 有人在等我，但这就是自然。我必须接受。

cues.en: Routes to and from Singapore, along with major international flights to Doha, Sydney and Kuala Lumpur, have all been affected.
cues.zh: 往返新加坡的航线，以及飞往多哈、悉尼和吉隆坡的主要国际航班，都受到了影响。

cues.en: On the ground, residents of Jakarta and other cities have been sweeping up the ash outside their homes.
cues.zh: 在地面上，雅加达和其他城市的居民一直在清扫家门外的火山灰。

cues.en: They've been advised to wear masks and eye protection and to remain indoors.
cues.zh: 他们被建议戴口罩和护目装备，并留在室内。

cues.en: Fishing boats and other vessels have been banned from within three kilometres of the active crater.
cues.zh: 渔船和其他船只被禁止进入活跃火山口周围3公里以内。

cues.en: The sea level is being monitored, but the authorities say the likelihood of a tsunami is low.
cues.zh: 有关方面正在监测海平面，但表示发生海啸的可能性很低。

cues.en: Lisa Tambunan in Jakarta.
cues.zh: 丽莎·坦布南在雅加达报道。

cues.en: Reports of people being sexually assaulted after having their drinks spiked have risen substantially in recent years,
cues.zh: 近年来，关于人们饮料被下药后遭受性侵的报告大幅增加，

cues.en: prompting a search for a simple way of testing whether drugs have been added to a drink.
cues.zh: 促使人们寻找一种简单的方法，检测饮料中是否被加入了药物。

cues.en: Well, over the weekend, thousands of date rape drug-detecting wristbands were handed out at a concert in Portugal.
cues.zh: 本周末，在葡萄牙一场音乐会上发放了数千条检测约会强奸药物的手环。

cues.en: More details from Wendy Urquhart.
cues.zh: 更多详情请听温迪·厄克特的报道。

cues.en: Imagine the horror of waking up in a strange place with people you've never met and realizing you've been sexually assaulted or raped.
cues.zh: 想象一下，在陌生的地方醒来，身边是从未见过的人，才意识到自己遭到了性侵或强奸，这是多么可怕。

cues.en: That happens to many people, especially women, whose drinks have been spiked
cues.zh: 许多人，尤其是女性，都经历过这种事；她们的饮料被下了药，

cues.en: with drugs that cause dizziness or make them pass out and remember nothing about what's happened.
cues.zh: 药物会导致头晕、昏厥，让她们完全记不起发生了什么。

cues.en: And the majority of these attacks are never reported.
cues.zh: 而且，这些袭击大多从未被报告。

cues.en: It's become such a major problem that countries all over the world
cues.zh: 这已经成为一个严重问题，世界各国

cues.en: are trying to come up with a solution
cues.zh: 都在努力寻找解决办法，

cues.en: that not only protects people, but is also fashion-friendly and easy to wear.
cues.zh: 这种办法不仅能保护人们，还要兼具时尚感、便于佩戴。

cues.en: At the weekend, 5,000 wristbands.
cues.zh: 周末，5000只手环。

cues.en: that were developed by researchers at Lisbon University in collaboration with the University of Valencia and the Spanish company Celentis
cues.zh: 这些手环由里斯本大学研究人员与瓦伦西亚大学及西班牙公司 Celentis 合作研发，

cues.en: were handed out at a DJ Carl Cox concert in Lisbon,
cues.zh: 在里斯本 DJ 卡尔·考克斯的一场音乐会上发放，

cues.en: And there are plans to distribute thousands more at other events in Portugal.
cues.zh: 葡萄牙还计划在其他活动上发放数千只。

cues.en: So how does it work?
cues.zh: 那么，它是如何运作的？

cues.en: Well, all you have to do is put a tiny amount of liquid from your glass onto a spot on the wristband.
cues.zh: 你只需把杯中少量液体滴到手环上的一个检测点。

cues.en: If it turns orange, everything's fine.
cues.zh: 如果变成橙色，就说明一切正常。

cues.en: But if it turns a greenish colour, it means your drink has been tampered with.
cues.zh: 但如果变成绿色，就说明你的饮料被动过手脚。

cues.en: It's an idea that's gone down very well with these users.
cues.zh: 这个想法很受这些使用者欢迎。

cues.en: I think it's a good thing, because it ends up giving us some peace of mind.
cues.zh: 我觉得这很好，最终能让我们安心一些。

cues.en: The pressure is on women because they end up being the victims of more situations where their drinks might be spiked.
cues.zh: 女性承受的压力更大，因为她们更常成为饮料可能被下药情形的受害者。

cues.en: As a woman, I thought it was wonderful, because I feel safer.
cues.zh: 作为女性，我觉得这太棒了，因为我感到更安全。

cues.en: I just put some of my drink on it to test it.
cues.zh: 我只要滴一点饮料上去就能检测。

cues.en: I think the city council initiative is great.
cues.zh: 我觉得市议会的倡议很棒。

cues.en: Several other countries have used jewellery, straws, and even magnets to detect drugs such as GHB, ketamine, and MDMA.
cues.zh: 其他一些国家也用首饰、吸管甚至磁铁检测 GHB、氯胺酮和 MDMA 等毒品。

cues.en: And Portugal is hoping this wristband will also help protect people from dangerous predators.
cues.zh: 葡萄牙希望这种手环也能帮助人们防范危险的加害者。

cues.en: Wendy Urquhart.
cues.zh: 温迪·厄克特报道。

cues.en: In recent years, Nigeria has been scarred by a series of mass school abductions.
cues.zh: 近年来，尼日利亚屡遭大规模校园绑架事件的创伤。

cues.en: Gunmen launch lightning raids and take dozens, even hundreds, of children away to captivity.
cues.zh: 枪手发动突袭，把几十名、甚至数百名儿童掳走囚禁。

cues.en: The country is already struggling with poor access to education.
cues.zh: 这个国家本已在艰难应对教育资源匮乏。

cues.en: The UN says about 19 million kids are missing out on school.
cues.zh: 联合国称，约1900万儿童无法上学。

cues.en: Many parents are simply too scared to send their sons and daughters to class.
cues.zh: 许多父母只是因为害怕，不敢送子女去上课。

cues.en: Yemisi Adegoke has been to northwest Nigeria to meet two young people caught up in an attack on their school.
cues.zh: 耶米西·阿德戈克前往尼日利亚西北部，见到了两名卷入校园袭击的年轻人。

cues.en: I've just arrived at the school, and the senior girls are out in the courtyard.
cues.zh: 我刚到学校，高年级女生们正在庭院里。

cues.en: They're wearing bright green uniforms, and it's raining a little bit, but they're just carrying on regardless.
cues.zh: 她们穿着鲜绿色校服，天在下小雨，但她们仍继续活动。

cues.en: One of the pupils singing and dancing here ahead of the end of school is Hannatu.
cues.zh: 临近放学时，在这里唱歌跳舞的学生之一是哈娜图。

cues.en: Like many teenage girls here in Gusau in northwest Nigeria, she's nervous about her exam results.
cues.zh: 和尼日利亚西北部古绍的许多少女一样，她对考试成绩感到紧张。

cues.en: The BBC has followed Hannatu's story closely ever since a shocking, life-changing incident.
cues.zh: 自那场令人震惊、改变人生的事件以来，BBC 一直密切跟进哈娜图的故事。

cues.en: I remember it often.
cues.zh: 我经常想起那件事。

cues.en: It makes me feel sad, and I cry.
cues.zh: 那让我感到悲伤，我会哭。

cues.en: Reports say a large number of schoolgirls have been abducted after gunmen stormed a government school and kidnapped them from their dormitories.
cues.zh: 报道称，大批女学生在枪手闯入一所公立学校后被从宿舍绑走。

cues.en: This part of Nigeria has been plagued by motorbike-riding gangs of bandits who abduct people for ransom.
cues.zh: 尼日利亚这一地区饱受骑摩托车的匪帮困扰，他们绑架人质索要赎金。

cues.en: In Zamfara State, almost half a million children are out of school, partly driven by fears over abductions.
cues.zh: 在扎姆法拉州，近50万儿童失学，部分原因是人们担心遭到绑架。

cues.en: After the attack, Hannatu spoke to BBC Africa Eye.
cues.zh: 袭击发生后，哈娜图接受了 BBC《非洲之眼》采访。

cues.en: We heard gunshots, people crying for help and shouting.
cues.zh: 我们听到枪声，人们哭喊求救。

cues.en: Here come the bandits!
cues.zh: 匪徒来了！

cues.en: About five of us ran and locked ourselves in the toilets.
cues.zh: 我们大约五个人跑进厕所，把自己锁在里面。

cues.en: There were about 350 students in the school.
cues.zh: 学校里大约有350名学生。

cues.en: But only 32 of us escaped.
cues.zh: 但只有32人逃了出来。

cues.en: Umu was another pupil at the school and was one of those abducted.
cues.zh: 乌穆是这所学校的另一名学生，也是被绑架者之一。

cues.en: She now studies early childhood education at a nearby university, but she was deeply affected by the incident.
cues.zh: 她如今在附近大学学习幼儿教育，但那次事件给她留下了深刻影响。

cues.en: I heard a man's voice shouting, 'Come out or I'll kill you!'
cues.zh: 我听到一个男人喊：‘出来，否则我就杀了你！’

cues.en: I was thinking that they would kill us.
cues.zh: 我当时想，他们会杀了我们。

cues.en: Nearly 300 girls were taken.
cues.zh: 将近300名女孩被带走。

cues.en: They were eventually freed, but it's disputed as to whether a ransom was paid for their release.
cues.zh: 她们最终获释，但是否支付赎金换取释放仍有争议。

cues.en: But the girls' school remained closed, threatening their futures.
cues.zh: 但女孩们的学校仍然关闭，威胁着她们的未来。

cues.en: Nigeria already has one of the highest rates of out-of-school children in the world.
cues.zh: 尼日利亚的失学儿童比例已经位居世界最高之列。

cues.en: Missing out on education can have devastating consequences, especially for girls.
cues.zh: 失去受教育机会可能造成毁灭性后果，女孩尤其如此。

cues.en: After the BBC filmed with Hannatu and Umu, donors reached out via the Ilimi Children's Fund.
cues.zh: BBC 拍摄哈娜图和乌穆的故事后，捐助者通过伊利米儿童基金会联系了她们。

cues.en: They offered to help some of the girls affected.
cues.zh: 他们提出帮助部分受影响的女孩。

cues.en: This allowed them to attend a secure school in the state capital.
cues.zh: 这让她们得以在州首府一所安全的学校就读。

cues.en: Both Hannatu and Umu now dream of careers where they can help others.
cues.zh: 哈娜图和乌穆如今都梦想从事帮助他人的职业。

cues.en: I want to be a doctor,
cues.zh: 我想成为一名医生，

cues.en: so I can help the community and my relatives and the people that have supported me.
cues.zh: 这样我就能帮助社区、亲人以及支持过我的人。

cues.en: The attack on their old school changed their lives, but Hannatu and Umu are determined that it will not define them.
cues.zh: 袭击改变了她们的人生，但哈娜图和乌穆决心不让这件事定义自己。

cues.en: Yemisi Adegoke.
cues.zh: 耶米西·阿德戈克报道。

cues.en: That is all from us for now, but the Global News Podcast will be back very soon.
cues.zh: 目前就到这里，全球新闻播客很快会再次与大家见面。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Sydney Dundon. Our editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 本期由悉尼·邓登混音，编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 我是奥利弗·康韦。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再见，拜拜。
